text:
Predicates:
Appropriate(x) ::: a film x is appropriate for people of all ages
WatchWithoutGuidance(x) ::: children can watch film x without guidance from parents
ExcessiveContent(x) ::: a film x contains excessive erotic and violent content
RatedGA(x) ::: a film x is rated General Audience
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) ::: a film x is a family-friendly animated film
FrozenSeries(x) ::: a film x is in the 'Frozen' series
Film(x) ::: x is a film
Premises:
∀x (Appropriate(x) → WatchWithoutGuidance(x)) ::: If a film is appropriate for people of all ages, then children can watch it without guidance from parents.
∀x (ExcessiveContent(x) → ¬WatchWithoutGuidance(x)) ::: If a film contains excessive erotic and violent content, children cannot watch it without guidance from their parents.
∀x (RatedGA(x) → Appropriate(x)) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, then it is appropriate for people of all ages.
∀x (FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) → RatedGA(x)) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
∀x (FrozenSeries(x) → FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x)) ::: All movies in the Frozen series are family-friendly animated films.
Film(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is a film.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(hachi) ⊕ Appropriate(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either a family-friendly animated film or is appropriate for people of all ages.
Conclusion:
ExcessiveContent(hachi) ∨ FrozenSeries(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' contains excessive erotic and violent content or is in the 'Frozen' series or both.
